Here’s a quick‑look at the Canadian long weekends for 2023 (i.e., holidays that line up with a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break).  The dates shown are the *actual* holiday dates; if a holiday falls on a weekend it’s usually observed on the nearest weekday, which can also create a long weekend.

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Type | Notes |
|---------|-----------|-----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Good Friday** | **April 7 (Friday)** | – | Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday | Always a long weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** | **May 24 (Monday)** | – | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday | Always a long weekend. |
| **Canada Day** | **July 1 (Saturday)** | Observed Monday July 3 | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday | Observed on Monday, still a long weekend. |
| **Labour Day** | **September 4 (Monday)** | – | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday | Always a long weekend. |
| **Thanksgiving** | **October 9 (Monday)** | – | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday | Always a long weekend. |
| **Remembrance Day** | **November 11 (Saturday)** | Observed Monday November 13 | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday | Observed on Monday, still a long weekend. |
| **Christmas Day** | **December 25 (Monday)** | – | Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday | Always a long weekend. |

### Quick Summary

- **7 Apr** – Good Friday (Fri‑Sat‑Sun)  
- **24 May** – Victoria Day (Sat‑Sun‑Mon)  
- **3 Jul** – Canada Day (observed) (Sat‑Sun‑Mon)  
- **4 Sep** – Labour Day (Sat‑Sun‑Mon)  
- **9 Oct** – Thanksgiving (Sat‑Sun‑Mon)  
- **13 Nov** – Remembrance Day (observed) (Sat‑Sun‑Mon)  
- **25 Dec** – Christmas Day (Sat‑Sun‑Mon)

These are the only statutory holidays in Canada that give you a full three‑day weekend in 2023. If you’re planning trips, you’ll have seven solid long‑weekend windows to work with!
